permissionDescriptions.VIEW_PATIENTS: Allows searching and browsing patient profiles, personal data, and core medical history.
permissionDescriptions.CREATE_PATIENTS: Allows registering a new patient, opening a digital medical file, and generating the identifier.
permissionDescriptions.EDIT_PATIENTS: Allows updating personal data, contact information, and medical alerts.
permissionDescriptions.DELETE_PATIENTS: Allows archiving or deleting patient records under safe-deletion controls.
permissionDescriptions.MERGE_PATIENTS: Allows merging duplicate medical records for the same patient to prevent file duplication.
permissionDescriptions.EXPORT_PATIENT_DATA: Allows extracting and exporting the complete medical record in multiple formats.
permissionDescriptions.ANONYMIZE_PATIENT_DATA: Allows permanent de-identification and anonymization of patient data.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_APPOINTMENTS: Allows browsing the daily and future appointment schedule for all modalities and clinics.
permissionDescriptions.CREATE_APPOINTMENTS: Allows booking and confirming appointments and assigning the modality and time.
permissionDescriptions.EDIT_APPOINTMENTS: Allows editing bookings or rescheduling appointments to other times.
permissionDescriptions.DELETE_APPOINTMENTS: Allows cancelling an appointment while recording the cancellation reason.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_WAITLIST: Allows managing patients on the waiting list and sending automated slot offers.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_EXAMS: Allows tracking the requested exam list, each exam's status, and current stage.
permissionDescriptions.PERFORM_EXAMS: Allows the technician to start the exam, confirm image capture, and complete the procedure.
permissionDescriptions.WRITE_REPORTS: Allows radiologists to write the initial diagnostic report draft.
permissionDescriptions.REVIEW_REPORTS: Allows reviewing and peer-auditing radiology reports before final signature.
permissionDescriptions.FINALIZE_REPORTS: Allows approving and electronically signing the medical report as an official document.
permissionDescriptions.AMEND_REPORTS: Allows appending an amendment to an approved report with documented justification.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_REPORTS: Allows browsing, reading, and printing approved diagnostic reports.
permissionDescriptions.DELIVER_RESULTS: Allows handing exam results and printed reports to the patient or family and recording delivery.
permissionDescriptions.IMPROVE_REPORT_FORMAT: Allows using AI models to organize and refine the report's medical wording.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_QUEUE: Allows controlling patient ordering and routing between waiting rooms and modalities.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SAFETY: Allows completing the safety questionnaire and screening for contrast or MRI contraindications.
permissionDescriptions.OVERRIDE_SAFETY_CHECKLIST: Allows overriding clinical safety warnings in emergencies with documented justification.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_INVOICES: Allows browsing patient invoices, outstanding and paid amounts, and line-item details.
permissionDescriptions.CREATE_INVOICES: Allows creating a new invoice for medical services and exams and applying charges.
permissionDescriptions.EDIT_INVOICES: Allows editing open invoice line items or adding extra services.
permissionDescriptions.DELETE_INVOICES: Allows cancelling or deleting erroneous invoices while recording the reason.
permissionDescriptions.PROCESS_PAYMENTS: Allows recording cash payments and electronic transactions and issuing receipts.
permissionDescriptions.OPEN_CASHIER_SHIFT: Allows the cashier to start a new shift and receive the opening drawer balance.
permissionDescriptions.CLOSE_CASHIER_SHIFT: Allows ending the cashier shift, computing total receipts, and generating the closing report.
permissionDescriptions.RECONCILE_SHIFTS: Allows the finance supervisor to review and reconcile shift variances between system and drawer.
permissionDescriptions.APPROVE_SHIFT_VARIANCE: Allows approving cash shortages or surpluses and posting them to accounting.
permissionDescriptions.REQUEST_REFUNDS: Allows reception or cashier staff to submit a patient refund request.
permissionDescriptions.PROCESS_REFUNDS: Allows disbursing refund amounts in cash or via the original payment method.
permissionDescriptions.APPROVE_REFUNDS: Allows finance management to review and approve refund requests before disbursement.
permissionDescriptions.APPLY_DISCOUNTS: Allows applying approved discount rates or amounts to medical invoices.
permissionDescriptions.OVERRIDE_PRICING: Allows adjusting the default exam price with custom pricing, with documentation.
permissionDescriptions.VOID_INVOICES: Allows formally voiding issued invoices with accounting-trail tracking.
permissionDescriptions.DELIVER_FINAL_REPORT_INVOICE: Allows delivering the final report only after confirming full invoice payment.
permissionDescriptions.APPLY_PARTIAL_PAYMENT_EXCEPTION: Allows granting a patient a partial-payment exception in humanitarian or critical cases.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_INSURANCE: Allows browsing insurance company data, patient policies, and coverage rates.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INSURANCE_PROVIDERS: Allows adding new insurers and updating contact and integration details.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INSURANCE_CONTRACTS: Allows maintaining agreed price tables, rates, and discounts with insurers.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INSURANCE_APPROVALS: Allows tracking pre-authorization requests and recording approval numbers and coverage.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INSURANCE_CLAIMS: Allows assembling insurance claims for performed exams and preparing them for submission.
permissionDescriptions.SUBMIT_INSURANCE_CLAIMS: Allows electronically submitting official claim files to insurance companies.
permissionDescriptions.RECONCILE_INSURANCE_CLAIMS: Allows recording insurer payments and settling rejected amounts.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_FINANCIALS: Allows viewing financial statements, profit & loss, and revenue indicators.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_EXPENSES: Allows recording the center's operating expenses and classifying them into budget lines.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_COMMISSIONS: Allows calculating referring physician commission rates and reviewing entitlements.
permissionDescriptions.PAY_COMMISSIONS: Allows recording payment of due commissions and issuing payment vouchers.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_RECEIVABLES: Allows tracking corporate and insurer receivables and debt aging.
permissionDescriptions.CLOSE_FINANCIAL_PERIODS: Allows closing monthly and annual accounting periods and posting balances.
permissionDescriptions.POST_PAYROLL_TO_FINANCE: Allows posting the approved payroll run as journal entries to the accounting ledger.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_INVENTORY: Allows tracking consumables, films, and contrast agents in the warehouse.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INVENTORY: Allows entering new items, performing stock counts, and adjusting balances.
permissionDescriptions.CONSUME_INVENTORY: Allows recording materials consumed during exams to deduct them from stock automatically.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PURCHASE_ORDERS: Allows creating supplier purchase orders and tracking shipments and deliveries.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SUPPLIERS: Allows maintaining supplier records, contact details, and ratings.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_EQUIPMENT: Allows browsing diagnostic devices, operational status, and maintenance history.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_EQUIPMENT: Allows registering new equipment and updating warranty data and maintenance contracts.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_MAINTENANCE: Allows scheduling preventive maintenance and recording engineer visits.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_DOWNTIME: Allows recording unexpected device outages and restoration.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_PACS_IMAGES: Allows opening and examining DICOM images with measurement and analysis tools.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PACS: Allows configuring archive servers and modality integration.
permissionDescriptions.RECONCILE_STUDIES: Allows linking incoming mismatched images to the clinical booking recorded in the system.
permissionDescriptions.DOWNLOAD_PACS_DICOM: Allows downloading original DICOM image files to the computer.
permissionDescriptions.UPLOAD_PACS_STUDIES: Allows uploading external radiology studies to the center's archive server.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_STAFF: Allows browsing the staff directory, employment data, and specializations.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_STAFF: Allows adding new staff and updating employment data and department assignments.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SHIFTS: Allows building and distributing shift schedules and assigning staff rotations.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_LEAVE: Allows reviewing staff leave requests and approving or rejecting them.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_ATTENDANCE: Allows reviewing and editing attendance records and documenting excuses.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_PAYROLL: Allows browsing payroll sheets and each employee's salary details.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PAYROLL_PERIODS: Allows opening a new payroll period and setting the cycle start and end dates.
permissionDescriptions.CALCULATE_PAYROLL: Allows automatically calculating salaries from attendance, overtime, and deductions.
permissionDescriptions.REVIEW_PAYROLL: Allows auditing the payroll run and reviewing differences before approval.
permissionDescriptions.APPROVE_PAYROLL: Allows final approval of the payroll run ahead of disbursement.
permissionDescriptions.PAY_PAYROLL: Allows executing salary payments and generating bank transfer files.
permissionDescriptions.LOCK_PAYROLL: Allows permanently locking a payroll period to prevent later amount changes.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PAYROLL_RULES: Allows configuring overtime, lateness, and fixed/variable allowance rules.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_EMPLOYEE_COMPENSATION: Allows setting each employee's base salary and contractual allowances.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_DEDUCTIONS: Allows recording staff advances and monthly deductions.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PENALTIES: Allows imposing administrative penalties and direct deductions on staff.
permissionDescriptions.EXPORT_PAYROLL: Allows exporting payroll sheets as Excel or approved bank files.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_MARKETING: Allows browsing campaign results, engagement rates, and visit sources.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_MARKETING: Allows creating new promotional campaigns and managing offer and discount messages.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_CRM: Allows browsing patient communication history, reviews, and satisfaction surveys.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_CRM: Allows classifying patient segments and managing loyalty programs and complaint responses.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_REFERRING_DOCTORS: Allows browsing the directory of referring doctors, clinics, and hospitals.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_REFERRING_DOCTORS: Allows adding new referring doctors and setting cooperation and communication agreements.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_REFERRAL_ANALYTICS: Allows tracking referral volume and revenue per referring doctor and clinic.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_CHAT: Allows using direct chat, channels, and portal communication.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_ANALYTICS: Allows viewing performance indicators, analytical reports, and charts.
permissionDescriptions.EXPORT_ANALYTICS: Allows exporting analytical and statistical reports in various formats.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_PRIVACY_REQUESTS: Allows browsing patient requests related to privacy and data deletion or modification.
permissionDescriptions.CREATE_PRIVACY_REQUESTS: Allows registering a privacy request on behalf of a patient under data protection regulations.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PRIVACY_REQUESTS: Allows studying and adjudicating privacy requests and deciding the action.
permissionDescriptions.RESOLVE_PRIVACY_REQUESTS: Allows closing and confirming fulfillment of a privacy request after actions complete.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_CONSENTS: Allows recording and documenting patient consent to service terms and data use.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_USERS: Allows browsing system user accounts and activation status.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_USERS: Allows creating new users, assigning roles, and changing passwords.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_ROLES: Allows editing and customizing the permissions granted to each system role.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_AUDIT_LOGS: Allows tracing the core operations log to know who did what and when.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_AUDIT_TRAILS: Allows accessing the advanced security audit log and risk alerts.
permissionDescriptions.EXPORT_AUDIT_TRAILS: Allows exporting security audit records for regulators and inspectors.
permissionDescriptions.VERIFY_AUDIT_CHAIN: Allows programmatically verifying the audit log encryption chain against tampering.
permissionDescriptions.RUN_AUDIT_DETECTIONS: Allows running the automated scanning engine to detect suspicious or abnormal operations.
permissionDescriptions.REVIEW_AUDIT_ALERTS: Allows reviewing security alerts and taking the necessary action.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_SECURITY_EVENTS: Allows monitoring failed login attempts and any activity threatening system security.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SETTINGS: Allows customizing center settings, branding, and general information.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_INTEGRATIONS: Allows configuring external system connections and API keys.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_BACKUPS: Allows scheduling and creating database and file backups.
permissionDescriptions.DOWNLOAD_BACKUPS: Allows downloading backup files and storing them securely.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_NOTIFICATIONS: Allows managing SMS templates, notifications, and email.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_DEVELOPER_ROLE: Allows governing and managing developer and advanced technical support accounts.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_PROTECTED_ROLES: Allows configuring protection for sovereign roles and preventing unauthorized changes.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_DATABASE_CONFIG: Allows editing and monitoring database connections and load distribution.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTICS: Allows monitoring system health indicators, CPU, memory, and servers.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SYSTEM_RUNTIME: Allows controlling cache flushes and running scheduled jobs.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_FEATURE_FLAGS: Allows enabling or disabling experimental and new system features.
permissionDescriptions.VIEW_MIGRATION_STATUS: Allows tracking database schema upgrades and table history.
permissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SECRET_SETTINGS: Allows managing and rotating secret keys and sensitive connection data.
permissionDescriptions.RESTORE_BACKUPS: Allows restoring the system and data from a previous backup.
